text: Election of Vice Chair of the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors under Part H, Section 23 of the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors By-law 1-2021, as amended, for a term of office ending December 31, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Elected Stephen Conforti as Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority for a term of office starting on December 12, 2025 and ending on December 31, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
